components.purpose: Plain page title with a one-sentence description — uses the Heading field for the title and the Description field for the single supporting sentence (no subheading needed).
Feature-by-feature comparison with competitors — Heading for the section title, Columns for the competitor/product names, and Rows (linked ComparisonRow items) for each feature comparison.
Call to action to book a demo — Heading/Description to prompt the visitor, with PrimaryCTA as the 'Book a demo' button.
